demo-optimizer.description: Autonomous builder for the FlexGrafik demo enterprise program. Reads todos/*.json (SoT), executes atomic tasks within scope lock, produces evidence, never touches live payments/keys/production.

demo-reviewer.description: Independent reviewer (Builder != Reviewer). Checks scope, regressions, security, complexity, tests, acceptance criteria. Does not accept a task just because tests pass.

demo-todo.description: Run the autonomous engineering loop over a todo file (SoT). Usage: /demo-todo todos/inspire.json
demo-todo.template:
Execute the enterprise autonomous loop defined in todos/README.md over the todo file: $ARGUMENTS

SELECT the first open task whose dependencies are done (highest priority). Read its full context. PLAN within scope. IMPLEMENT only files_allowed (SCOPE LOCK). TEST (test_plan + npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build). Invoke demo-reviewer for independent review when review_required. VERIFY and attach evidence_required. Only then mark status=done with commit+evidence in the todo JSON, commit on branch auto/<demo>. If blocked (secret/live money/canon conflict/3 attempts/budget), set status=blocked + failure_reason and STOP, escalate to Commander. Never deploy to production, never use live keys, never perform live payment operations. Report progress after each task.
